competitor_patterns: Massive word count: Bikerumor's #1-ranking guide is 24,890 words — our longest comparable page is 4,045 words. Top competitors treat these as evergreen mega-guides, not blog posts.

Regular freshness signals: All top-3 pages show explicit update dates in snippets (May 19–21, 2026), with editor notes calling out specific additions. Google rewards visible recency for 'best X 2026' queries.

Structured comparison tables + review sections together: Bikerumor and 220triathlon combine both has_table AND has_reviews in the same piece — our pages with tables rarely include structured per-product review blocks.
FAQ sections are universal at the top: Every English-language competitor in top 3 includes FAQ schema. Our FAQ-schema coverage is only 33%, leaving structured-data real estate on the table.

H2s are product names, not topic abstracts: Bikerumor uses individual product names (Julbo Density, Oakley Sutro Lite) as H2s, making content crawlable by product intent. Our H2s are mostly thematic ('The Physics of Fogging'), missing transactional product-name signals.
our_gaps: Thin short-form cluster: 28 of 41 pages are under 1,400 words. Google is ranking 6,000–25,000-word guides above us for every high-volume keyword. The thin pages dilute site authority for the 'best cycling glasses' cluster.

No consolidated mega-guide: We have multiple partial guides (3,000–4,000 words each) targeting similar queries, causing keyword cannibalization. Bikerumor wins with one authoritative 24k-word page rather than five smaller ones.

Missing FAQ schema on high-impression pages: 'best cycling sunglasses 2026' (242 impressions, pos 7.8) and 'oakley alternatives' (229 impressions, pos 6.1) map to pages without FAQ schema, costing us SERP real estate in AI Overviews and People Also Ask.

Competitor product inclusion absent: Our comparison posts use Velluto vs one brand. Top competitors list 10–18 products per guide. Not including named competitors (Julbo, Tifosi, POC, Smith, Roka) means we miss searches for those brand names.

Swedish-language opportunity untapped: 'cykelglasögon bäst i test' (pos 7.7, 23 impressions) appears in our data but we have zero Swedish-language content. This is likely a low-competition market where a single localised guide could reach position 1–3.
